name: formora-soil-irrigation-system
description: Formora - Soil Irrigation System fullstack application with ESP32 telemetry, automated watering control, SQLite database, and Android APK support

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.render:build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.android:build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run cap:sync
